per_shot.note: Real hab shell now (ribbed ceiling, fixtures, riveted panels, red stripe, dusk portholes) but the floor is a mirror: long vertical streaks and a cyan smear under the terminal read as wet glass, not a home.
Warm ceiling cones on the wall are good; the floor reflections dominate the lower half and the wall is one uniform panel field.
Fridge, porthole and corkboard sit well in the warm light; streaky glossy floor again; dark right doorway is a nice contrast corner.
Fern, patterned rug, radio with lit dial and books all read; clearly richer than stock, but the glossy floor streaks pull focus away from the furnishings.
Arc lamp pools on the wall and floor; star chart reads but is dim and flat, almost a dark rectangle; cyan reflection streak still under the terminal.
Galley (kettle, cups, tiles) and bunk with bedding read well; bunk sconce is small and barely lands; Gallery door is a dark slot.

top_issues.issue: Floor is a near-mirror with long vertical light streaks
top_issues.why: Reads as wet glass or a showroom, not a lived-in deck plate; the streaks are the brightest, busiest thing in the lower half and compete with the suit.
top_issues.suggested_direction: Rougher, satin plating: keep warm pools where light lands but kill the long specular smears.

top_issues.issue: Cyan streak reflected under the terminal
top_issues.why: A cold off-hue smear in a warm sanctuary that looks like a rendering artifact.
top_issues.suggested_direction: Remove or heavily soften the screen's floor reflection.

top_issues.why: The star chart is a dim dark rectangle and the bunk sconce is a tiny point; bought things don't feel cared for or lit as features.
top_issues.suggested_direction: Give the chart a picture light and let the bunk sconce wash the wall and pillow warmly.

top_issues.issue: Wall is one uniform panel field
top_issues.why: Every bay is the same riveted plate and the stock room still feels a bit like a repeated corridor tile.
top_issues.suggested_direction: Vary bays: insulated quilted panels, inset grids, conduit runs, so value changes across the wall.

top_issues.why: The bottom 10% of the frame is a black striped slab that adds weight without information.
top_issues.suggested_direction: Lift it slightly into a lit sill or floor edge, or crop it tighter.

protect: Ribbed ceiling with recessed warm fixtures and beams; no black void
Dusk portholes as warm windows matching 02-surface
Warm cones of light on the wall from each fixture, with dark gaps between
Furnishings reading at play scale: patterned rug, fern, radio dial, books, kettle and cups, bunk bedding
Suit is the clearest, brightest figure in every frame

per_shot.note: Same shell as A but floor is satin with soft pools instead of mirror streaks, and an inset grid bay adds wall variety; lower floor has some blurry blotches.
Louvred/grid wall bays break the repeat; floor pools read as light landing; still plain as a stock room should be.
Calmer floor lets the fridge, porthole and corkboard lead; grid panel under the porthole helps; foreground floor has smudgy dark patches.
Radio glows and pools on the floor; book shelf has its own strip light; rug, fern read clearly; clearly richer than stock.
Star chart is now lit with a picture light and glows blue as a showpiece; arc lamp washes the wall and pools on the floor; warm and cared for.
Copper kettle catches light, galley shelf light, bunk sconce washes the wall and pillow, chart glows, warm rose spill from the Gallery door: the best frame.

top_issues.issue: Blurry blotchy patches across the near floor
top_issues.why: Soft dark and light smudges in the lower third read as smeared reflection or noisy AO, not as intentional pools; it slightly muddies the cleanest part of the frame.
top_issues.suggested_direction: Keep the satin floor but make the pools crisper and fewer, tied to visible sources, with plain mid-value plating between.

top_issues.why: Good shell, but with few bays varied and no conduit or insulated panels the unfurnished hall is decent rather than inviting.
top_issues.suggested_direction: A few more structural variations (quilted insulation, conduit drops, a floor hatch) in the stock shell.

top_issues.why: Bottom strip of the frame is a dark slab that adds weight without information.
top_issues.suggested_direction: Lift it into a lit floor edge or trim it.

top_issues.issue: Ceiling upper band falls to near-black
top_issues.why: Top ~15% of frame goes very dark; structure is there but barely reads at the top edge.
top_issues.suggested_direction: Faint bounce from the fixtures onto the upper ceiling panels so the ceiling reads as a surface all the way up.

protect: Satin floor with warm pools instead of mirror streaks
Picture light on the star chart and its blue glow
Bunk sconce washing the wall and pillow; galley shelf light on kettle and tiles
Inset grid / louvred wall bays that break the panel repeat
Ribbed ceiling with warm fixtures, dusk portholes, and the suit as the clearest figure

why: Same room, but B replaces A's wet-mirror floor streaks with satin pools, varies the wall bays, and lights the furnishings (star chart, bunk sconce, galley, shelf), so light lands warmly and bought things look cared for.
